notes.title: New Update: Fixing typos, random bugs and adding a cheat function!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

This might be a surprise, but I've made some slight changes to this 6 year-old game, including adding a brand new cheat function because the ways to get some of the endings are obscure and badly designed.

Hopefully this helps!

If you haven't already, feel free to check out my library of other games that are set in the same setting!

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.notes: Several bugs have been fixed and other minor improvements.
